nodes.label: Spacing scale (8px base, 8 steps)
nodes.rationale: sp-1 8, sp-2 16, sp-3 24, sp-4 32, sp-5 48, sp-6 64, sp-7 96, sp-8 128. Rule: 'gaps only, never per-element margins' -- spacing is owned by the container's gap, so no element carries its own margin and nothing collapses or double-spaces when blocks are reordered.
